notes_for_editor: Very thin: one 2016 map entry (tnlandforms GA393), whose only source note is 'aerial imagery'. The name 'lawson' is the map compiler's own label (entries 73 and above are named by the compiler). Searches found no Georgia record of a lookout called Lawson in Liberty County. A Wikidata item (Q107507016) and a Commons category name a different 'Lawson Lookout Tower' in Marshall County, Minnesota; the story mentions it only to warn against mixing them up. The map gives elevation with no unit; read as feet (record 25.6 m). Nothing found on build date, staffing, fate or access.
